name: Alandra, Sky Dreamer
oracle_text:
Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 2/2 blue Drake creature token with flying.
Whenever you draw your fifth card each turn, Alandra and Drakes you control each get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of cards in your hand.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 2/2 blue Drake creature token with flying.

needs.what: a token definition for a 2/2 blue Drake creature token with flying -- id `drake_2_2_u_flying`, name "Drake Token", types ["Creature"], subtypes ["Drake"], colors ["U"], color_identity ["U"], power 2, toughness 2, keywords ["flying"], is_token true -- added to data/cards/tokens.cards.json so `create_token` can name it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `create_token` carries only `token`, `amount`, `as`, `attacking`, `controller` and `tapped`: the `token` value is an id string naming a card already in the pool, there is no inline token body and no size, colour, subtype or keyword override on the op. `loader.validate_token_references` (src/automtg/cards/loader/linking.py) raises `references unknown card` at load time for any id that is absent or not marked `is_token`, so the card cannot ship ahead of the definition. The pool has no Drake token of any size -- the only blue fliers are `illusion_1_1_u_flying` (1/1, Illusion) and `vampire_2_2_b_flying` (right body, wrong colour and tribe); the nearest 2/2 blue creature is `komas_coil_3_3_u` at 3/3 with no flying. Substituting any of them would give the player a creature type this card's own second ability counts ("Drakes you control"), so an approximation would break the card's other half as well as its printed text. A token definition is data a card worker may not write, and this is the same block already recorded for Swan Song's Bird and Sokenzan's Spirit.
needs.blocks_only: the token clause; the rest of the card is expressible today

notes: Everything else this card prints already exists. "Whenever you draw your second/fifth card each turn" is a `draw` trigger with `controller: "you"` and `nth: 2` / `nth: 5` -- the loader accepts `nth` only on a draw event (src/automtg/cards/loader/__init__.py:1406) and templates.cards.json already ships an `nth: 2` draw trigger. "Alandra and Drakes you control each get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of cards in your hand" is a `pump` with `duration: "end_of_turn"`, `power` and `toughness` of `{"cards_in_hand": {"player": "you"}}`, over `{"union": [{"self_only": true}, {"zone": "battlefield", "controller": "you", "subtypes": ["Drake"]}], "count": "all"}`. So this card is one token definition away from shipping, and its expectation would then be a `tokens` assertion of `drake_2_2_u_flying` once a draw trigger can be made to fire -- absent that, `{"zone": "battlefield", "battlefield_count": 33}`.
